children: DOMO, INC. reported results for the quarter ended 2026 with revenue of $76.78M, a net loss of ($9.62M) and diluted loss per share of ($0.21), reflecting narrower losses versus the prior-year quarter.
¹ Reported as “Total revenue”. ² Reported as “Net loss”. ³ Reported as “loss per share, basic and diluted”.
Subscription revenue and total revenue declined modestly, with total revenue down about 4% as net expansion from existing customers softened.
Consumption-based pricing now represents 91% of ARR, indicating a substantial shift to usage-tier pricing with annual upfront commitments.
The company serves over 2,300 customers; enterprise accounts (>$1B) account for 44% of revenue and multi-year contracts support revenue predictability.
Management is prioritizing a land-expand-retain model, investing in product, customer success and an Appstore to boost in-platform discoverability and upsells.
Operating efficiency improved with lower sales & marketing and R&D spend as a percentage of revenue, while G&A increased due to transaction-related costs and legal fees.
